messages:
zia: Morning! starting my first day and trying to triage setup steps. Quick Q: who is the single point for repo access, infra creds, PagerDuty, Dedicated tenant access, and vendor console requests? Trying to avoid pinging 5 different teams in the first 48h.
clare: welcome @zia :wave: Short map: repo access -> eng-platform; infra creds & vault tokens -> eng-infra; PagerDuty & oncall invites -> eng-sre; Dedicated tenant/customer provisioning -> customer-success + solutions-eng; vendor/cloud console (AWS/GCP accounts) -> eng-infra ops + security approval.
omar: Practical steps: 1) repo perms: open the form at https://redwood.internal/perm-request and list repos + role. 2) infra creds: make a ticket in #help with subject "onboard: creds" and include your manager. 3) PD invites: use the onboarding form link in the handbook.
ben: For vendor consoles we require an IAM justification and a short access window. Security reviews are usually same-day if you attach the training cert. If you need emergency access ping @eng-infra and include the service name and reason.
oncall-bot: [automated] If paging oncall, include: service, region, impact, and a short log/sample command. Example:
```
service: inference-staging-us-west
env: staging
impact: 5xx on /health, 20% errors
example-log: tail -n 50 /var/log/inference/serve.log
```
zia: Good to know. If something is clearly networking (VPC peering) vs model-serving, how do we decide who to page?
clare: Rule of thumb: credentials/network/connectivity -> eng-infra. Model inference, KV cache, quantization regressions -> eng-runtime during business hours, otherwise page eng-sre. Broad customer-impact outages -> always page eng-sre and cc customer-success.
omar: Also: Dedicated customer incidents: always cc the account's CS rep. We have a dedicated runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-incident.
ben: Bookmark the DevEx who-to-ask page (owners: @clare and @omar) and feel free to open a PR if anything is missing: https://redwood.internal/devex/onboarding/who-to-ask.
zia: Amazing, thank you. I'll submit the repo/perms form and the cred ticket now. Appreciate the clear escalation lanes :pray:
